notes.title: More Colors and Accessories!
notes.content:
When you've finished a game with your friends, you'll now receive a new color or accessory as a reward! 

This was supposed to be in the first release, but apparently it wasn't working. Whoops!

notes.title: Ultimate Tag Releasing in a week (-ish)!
notes.content:
Wow! After a little over a year's work, Ultimate Tag will finally be releasing on July 5th! I can't believe it! And to think this all started as a one-off goofy project made in Python. But here we are, and I can't be happier! 
I uploaded the final build of the game to Steam today, and hopefully nothing majorly wrong will be found. I hope that everyone enjoys it when it releases! 

Game on! Tag ya later! 
-KarloKnows
